choices.text: Remind me of the three schools.
How did you end up here?

nodes.text: Sword: three cuts, third lands hardest, dash what you can't trade. Bow: Rill says full draw or nothing, and Rill is right. Spark: where you look, not where you wave. That's the drill. Go use it.

Inside the hedgerows, nothing will touch you. Past them it gets braver by the mile: stray wolves first, then camps with watch fires, and out where the maps give up, _things with names_. The road lamps are the only friendly lights out there. Mind your distance.

Wayward Watch, nine years, the long dark miles past the Last Lamp. Then a cart, a ditch, and a knee that's honest about rain and nothing else. The Watch sent me somewhere quiet. I drill wakers so the quiet stays quiet.
Then pass through. Mind the racks.
